description: 'the 1' is the perfect opener for folklore and the way she sings 'I'm doing good I'm on some new shit' as if she didn't just end the world?? 😭✨ It's about the one who got away and it hits way too hard for a Monday. It's understated but it's genius, and honestly a lot of the Joe Alwyn lore lives here. Not a banger but a mood, and I respect it 💅🥹
